item.p: 8.4 decode (): the built-in grammars, string tables and bit streams; every decode check of bit-packed, bit-packed-full, byte-alignment-full, string-limits, string-limits-zero and fragment passes (720 of 720) and is in the ratchet. Typed datatypes move to 8.9, where schemas need them.

8.1 and 8.2 done (): include/sxml/exi.h and the additive serialize.h, name.h and processor.h changes; the EXIficient oracle, the golden corpus of tests/exi (every option set), the driver exi_golden with its ratchet, and tools/exi/check-packet.sh.

The JavaScript package gets a release step (): a pushed tag runs .github/workflows/npm.yml, which builds, tests, packs and smoke-tests @tinyactors/sxml from the tag and stages it on npm; 0.2.0 was never published (npm answered 404).
